question: What nature reserve are located within 90 kilometers in the direction of travel from Cardiovascular Institute of New England, Cranston, RI to Acushnet Sawmill, Acushnet, MA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.472092 41.786868)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-70.919597 41.683778)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.472092 41.786868)',4326)::geography, 90000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.472092 41.786868)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
